question:
Which of the following is the correct match between column-A and column-B?

 
 

 
 
Colum - A

 
 
 
Column - B

 
 
 

 
 
i.

 
 
 
Producer

 
 
 
a.

 
 
 
Rabbit 

 
 
 

 
 
ii.

 
 
 
Primary consumer

 
 
 
b.

 
 
 
Green plants

 
 
 

 
 
iii.

 
 
 
Secondary consumer

 
 
 
c.

 
 
 
Bacteria and fungus

 
 
 

 
 
iv.

 
 
 
Decomposer

 
 
 
d.

 
 
 
Fox

options.text: i - b, ii - a, iii - d, iv - c
i - d, ii - c, iii - b, iv - a
i - a, ii - b, iii - c, iv - d
i - c, ii - d, iii - a, iv - b

solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 1: i - b, ii - a, iii - d, iv - c**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Producers** are organisms, like green plants, that produce their own food through photosynthesis.
 
• **Primary consumers** are herbivores, like rabbits, that eat producers.
 
• **Secondary consumers** are carnivores, like foxes, that eat primary consumers.
 
• **Decomposers** are organisms, like bacteria and fungi, that break down dead matter and waste.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Producers:**

 
 
• They are the base of the food chain and are typically green plants that use sunlight to make their own food through photosynthesis.
 
• Examples include trees, grasses, and algae.
 
 
 
• **Primary Consumers:**
 
 
• These are herbivores that feed directly on producers.
 
• Examples include rabbits, deer, and caterpillars.
 
 
 
• **Secondary Consumers:**
 
 
• These are carnivores that feed on primary consumers.
 
• Examples include foxes, snakes, and birds of prey.
 
 
 
• **Decomposers:**
 
 
• They play a crucial role in breaking down dead organisms and waste products, returning nutrients to the ecosystem.
 
• Examples include bacteria, fungi, and certain insects.
